title: Bug:bgpcfgd throws errors during handling of interface associated with VRF
author: dgsudharsan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Bgpcfgd lacks support for handling interfaces that are part of VRF. It throws error because the 'directory' datastructure where it handles the interface just uses ip address as key

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/90f84741c388fef110a83f5a6e582228ae52883d/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_intf.py#L38

With VRF, two different interfaces in different VRFs can have same IP. Hence during delete we may end up seeing errors like below

2026 Jun  9 17:29:15.916471 sonic DEBUG bgp#bgpcfgd: Received message : '('Vlan1002|2000:1:2::1/64', 'DEL', ())'
2026 Jun  9 17:29:15.920850 sonic DEBUG bgp#bgpcfgd: Received message : '('Vlan1002|2000:1:2::1/64', 'DEL', ())'
2026 Jun  9 17:29:15.920850 sonic WARNING bgp#bgpcfgd: Delete key 'Vlan1002|2000:1:2::1/64' is not supported for 'zebra set src' templates
2026 Jun  9 17:29:25.386032 sonic DEBUG bgp#bgpcfgd: Received message : '('Vlan1003|1.1.2.1/24', 'DEL', ())'
**2026 Jun  9 17:29:25.386166 sonic ERR bgp#bgpcfgd: Directory: Can't remove key '1.1.2.1' from slot 'LOCAL__local_addresses'. The key doesn't exist**

### Steps to Reproduce

Create two VLANs and bind them to two different VRFs.
Assign same ip address on them
Remove the IP addresses

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual behavior:**
Error logs are seen

**Expected behavior:**
No error logs seen

### Relevant log output

```shell
2026-06-09.17:27:18.689741|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1003:1.1.2.1/24|SET|scope:global|family:IPv4
2026-06-09.17:27:18.689755|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1003|SET|vrf_name:Vrf_0003|mac_addr:00:00:00:00:00:00
2026-06-09.17:27:18.689863|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1002:1.1.2.1/24|SET|scope:global|family:IPv4
2026-06-09.17:27:18.689876|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1002|SET|vrf_name:Vrf_0002|mac_addr:00:00:00:00:00:00
2026-06-09.17:29:13.148064|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1002:1.1.2.1/24|DEL
2026-06-09.17:29:25.390118|INTF_TABLE:Vlan1003:1.1.2.1/24|DEL
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
Will be seen on all versions. Day 1 issue.
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: Bojun-Feng
comments.body:
I looked into the issue, seems like we are using bare IP as the directory key for local addresses, which means two interfaces in different VRFs with the same IP overwrite each other. On delete, the first removal succeeds but the second fails because the key is gone.

Addition / Deletion is based on IP only:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/e7e2569b487323be00016ad0c981966e203df409/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_intf.py#L38
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/e7e2569b487323be00016ad0c981966e203df409/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_intf.py#L54

I have drafted a PR that changes local_addresses to use a composite key (`interface_name|ip`) so each entry is unique regardless of VRF overlap. The consumer is updated to iterate and match by IP suffix instead of direct lookup.

This introduces an O(n) scan where there was previously O(1), but `get_local_interface` is only called during `add_peer`, which is a config-time event, not dataplane. Also n is bounded by the number of IP-bearing interfaces on the switch, so I believe the cost is negligible relative to the overall convergence time.

linkedPullRequests.title: [bgpcfgd]: Use composite key for local_addresses to support VRF overlapping IPs
linkedPullRequests.author: Bojun-Feng
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/27800

bgpcfgd uses bare IP address as the key in its internal `local_addresses` directory slot. When two interfaces in different VRFs are assigned the same IP address, the second entry overwrites the first. On deletion, the first interface removes the key successfully, but the second deletion fails with "Can't remove key ... The key doesn't exist" because the entry was already gone. This is a Day 1 bug that affects any deployment using overlapping IPs across VRFs.

#### How I did it
* Use composite key `interface_name|ip` in `local_addresses` directory slot to ensure uniqueness across VRF-bound interfaces
* Update `get_local_interface` in managers_bgp.py to search entries by IP suffix in the composite key

#### How to verify it
1. Create two VLANs bound to different VRFs with the same IP (e.g., `Vlan1002` in `Vrf_0002` and `Vlan1003` in `Vrf_0003`, both with `1.1.2.1/24`)
2. Remove the IP addresses from both interfaces
3. Verify no "Can't remove key" errors appear in bgpcfgd logs

#### Description for the changelog
Fixed bgpcfgd key collision when the same IP address exists on different interfaces across VRFs
